preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() for c in s) or return_value == -1
postconditions.description: If the string contains no digits, the function returns -1.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() for c in s) and return_value == int(str(eval('*'.join(c for c in s if c.isdigit())))[len(str(eval('*'.join(c for c in s if c.isdigit())))) // 2 - 1]) if len(str(eval('*'.join(c for c in s if c.isdigit())))) % 2 == 1 else int(str(eval('*'.join(c for c in s if c.isdigit())))[len(str(eval('*'.join(c for c in s if c.isdigit())))) // 2 - 1:len(str(eval('*'.join(c for c in s if c.isdigit())))) // 2 + 1].lstrip('0'))
postconditions.description: If the string contains digits, the function returns the middle digit(s) of the product of the digits, with leading zeros removed if the product has an even number of digits.
